The 3-Day Itinerary

[ SCHEDULE // DAY 01 — DAY 03 ]
Day 01 // Arrival & Table
D—01

Tascas, Bolhão & The Penthouse Feast

Arrive in Porto and head straight to O Buraco for traditional Portuguese dishes. Draw our 3 dinner squads, grab fresh ingredients during a relaxed walk through town, unwind at the heated pool, and take over the two penthouse kitchens for a 3-course dinner.

O Buraco Mercado do Bolhão Heated Pool 2 Penthouses 3 Kitchen Squads
Midday // 12:30

Traditional Porto Tasca Lunch

Touch down in Porto and settle in for lunch at O Buraco ↗, a local “tasco” serving traditional Portuguese dishes. Right after lunch, we draw the 3 random teams for tonight’s dinner challenge.

Portuguese Tradition
After lunch // 14:30

Market Run and Check-In

Run through Mercado do Bolhão ↗ and nearby traditional grocers so each dinner squad can pick up fresh ingredients along the way. Coming from abroad? Bring a local recipe or flavor from home into your team’s course. Check-in at Savvy Signature ↗ and drop-off luggage and groceries

Walk & Shop
Afternoon // 15:30

Explore half-forgotten Porto or trendy Oporto

Two routes to choose from, depending on how adventurous everyone is feeling.

Option A: The forgotten corners of Porto

Distance: 7 km   ·   Total time: 2 hours

Stroll through the artists’ neighborhood, stop at a trendy new record store and bar, then discover Porto’s unexpected rural side. Follow a rough, abandoned railway line back toward the old heart of the city, taking in viewpoints, stairways, and repurposed terraces along the way.

View full-size route map ↗
Option B: Oporto’s commercial center

Distance: 4.5 km   ·   Total time: 1 hour

Explore churches, the cathedral, grand commercial palaces, and the former hub of local activity; now the commercialized Oporto calling card for visitors. Soak in the amazing views in one of the few traditional “esplanadas” left.

View full-size route map ↗
Explore
Late Afternoon // 17:30

Back to Savvy Signature & Heated Pool

Arrive at Savvy Signature Apartments (Rua do Sol 162), settle into the rooms, stock the fridges in the two penthouses, and enjoy the heated indoor pool, sauna, hot tub, game/cinema room, and terraces before dinner prep begins.

Unwind
Evening // 19:30

The 3-Course Penthouse Cook-Off

With our two spacious penthouse kitchens and terraces at Savvy Signature, our 3 randomly drawn squads take over the stoves (with the Main Courses squad always having the largest crew). Each team owns their course from shopping bag to plate.

SQUAD 01 // 5 PEOPLE
Entrées

Open the evening. Appetizers, small plates, and local specialties to kick off dinner.

SQUAD 02 // 6 PEOPLE (LARGEST)
Main Courses

The largest crew on the biggest job: the centerpiece dish for all 16 people.

SQUAD 03 // 5 PEOPLE
Desserts

Sweet finishers and late-night treats to carry the penthouse table into the night.

Penthouse Kitchens
Day 02 // The Build
D—02

“A Step Forward” & Hands-On Shipping

Early breakfast, PT-led body activation, and a 10-minute keynote. Then we split into 4 squads—each guided by our Tech Devs with our dev pipeline ready to go—so everyone experiences building something real from scratch.

PT Activation A Step Forward 4 Squads Dev as Tech Guide Mad Pizza Festival
Morning // 08:30

Team Breakfast & PT Activation

Start the day together over breakfast, followed by a physical activation session run by our Personal Trainers to get everyone energized and focused for the build ahead.

PT Session
Kickoff // 09:45

Main Event: “A Step Forward”

A sharp, 10-minute company session setting the stage, the vision, and the challenge for the day.

10 Min Keynote
Draft // 10:00

4 Squads: Tech Guides + Cross-Functional Builders

We form 4 build squads led by our 5 Tech Guides (Akma, Franko, Mariia, Hugo, and Gonçalo), paired with a random selection of non-tech teammates (Duarte, João, Tomás, Isabel, Rita, Ana, Tiago, Marta, and Bia). Simão & Pico roam across all teams to monitor, unblock, and jump in wherever needed. With our dev pipeline ready out of the box, everyone gets hands-on: shaping the flow, translations, copy, and testing side-by-side.

Everyone Builds
On The Fly // 13:00+

Mad Pizza Festival & Rolling Dinner

No rigid breaks interrupting the flow. Lunch is a Mad Pizza Festival brought right to the workspace, and dinner happens on the fly as teams iterate.

Mad Pizza
Late Hours // ∞

Open-Ended Sprint — Goal: QA / Prod Ready

Teams can push as late as they want. The mission is simple: end the night with a working feature that is genuinely QA and Production ready for tomorrow morning’s pitch.

QA / Prod Ready
Day 03 // The Pitch
D—03

5+5 Demos, 3 Votes Each & First to Prod

Morning breakfast and PT reset, followed by crisp 10-minute team showcases (5m pitch + 5m Q&A). Everyone gets 3 votes to crown the most interesting build that goes first into Production.

PT Session II 5m Pitch + 5m Q&A 3 Votes Per Person First to Prod Insparya Porto
Morning // 09:00

Breakfast & PT Morning Activation

Team breakfast followed by our PTs leading a morning activation session to shake off the late night and get everyone sharp for demo time.

PT Reset
Showtime // 10:30

The Pitch & Vote: 5 Min Demo + 5 Min Q&A

Each of the 4 squads gets 5 minutes to present and demo what they built, followed by 5 minutes of Q&A. Afterward, everyone in the room gets 3 votes—and we vote to decide which build is the most interesting to go first into Production.

3 Votes · 1st to Prod
Afternoon // 13:00+

Lunch, Insparya Porto Co-Working & Departures

Celebrate over a final Porto lunch together. Afterward, anyone staying for the afternoon is welcome to work from Insparya Porto, while others head out for their travel arrangements home.

Insparya / Travel

“One day to build together. Five minutes to pitch. Three votes each to decide what ships first to Production.”
